title: Universal Life Insurance Actuarial Grading Table: Surrender Charge Rates Within the Policy Year
content:
For a full surrender of an Ashgrove Universal Life Insurance policy, the schedule rate actually applied follows the policy year of the surrender, the policy year and the whole months elapsed in it being counted from the issue date to the surrender's effective date. Within a policy year the rate grades down from that year's schedule rate toward the next year's schedule rate (nothing, after the last year of the tier's schedule).

## Grading rule

| Policy year of the surrender | Rate applied |
|---|---|
| Policy year **6** or later (the monthly-grading policy year) | That year's schedule rate, stepped down for each whole month elapsed in the policy year by one twelfth of the difference between that year's rate and the next year's rate |
| Policy years **2** through 5 (from the quarterly-grading policy year until the monthly-grading policy year) | That year's schedule rate, stepped down for each whole quarter (three whole months) elapsed in the policy year by one quarter of that difference |
| Policy year 1 | That year's schedule rate, unchanged for the whole policy year |

## Worked readings (hypothetical, Ashgrove Protection UL schedule)

| Policy year | Whole months elapsed in it | Year's rate | Next year's rate | Steps | Rate applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 8 | 28.00 | 25.00 | none | 28.00 |
| 2 | 2 | 25.00 | 22.00 | 0 quarters | 25.00 |
| 3 | 7 | 22.00 | 19.00 | 2 quarters of 0.75 | 20.50 |
| 5 | 11 | 16.00 | 13.00 | 3 quarters of 0.75 | 13.75 |
| 6 | 0 | 13.00 | 10.00 | 0 months | 13.00 |
| 7 | 5 | 10.00 | 7.00 | 5 months of 0.25 | 8.75 |
| 10 | 6 | 2.00 | nothing | 6 months of one twelfth of 2.00 | 1.00 |

A month counts only when it is complete: a surrender effective two months and twenty days into the policy year has two whole months elapsed and, in policy years 2 through 5, no whole quarter. The rate applied is not rounded on its own.
